title: Manyhands JSON v1 remote resolve-history preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of remote resolve-history: the repository-wide cache-loss flag is set and no context reads unknown, so it can be cleared. A flag already clear is a no-op (already_applied); a context that still reads unknown is a rejection (recovery_required), whose way out is remote history and item resolve-history.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: What clearing the flag will do.

root.description: The repository's root, as the request's records name it.

marker_present.description: Whether the cache-loss marker file is there to be deleted after the commit.
